utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Mara — I’m still catching up through Faye, but I heard the repair drive is 10 to noon and Eli’s sorting the list; could you confirm before I pass any tool details along?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, that’s right—Saturday 10 to noon, with Faye and me coordinating and Eli keeping the repair list organized. Tool details would be great; please send what you know and I’ll match them to the item categories.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, thanks Mara — I’ll keep it cautious and send you the tool notes I’ve only heard second-hand, mostly around small appliances and bikes, so you can sort what’s actually useful.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Vik, I’m spreading the word about Saturday’s repair drive—it’s 10 to noon with Faye and Mara coordinating. Want me to add you to the invite list or connect you with Eli about tools?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yes, add me to the invite list, please—and if you can connect me with Eli about the tool and drop-off details, I’ll pass that along to Jules, Ira, Sam, and Dane.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, Vik—I’ll add you to the invite list and connect you with Eli for the tool and drop-off details. Thanks for passing it along to Jules, Ira, Sam, and Dane!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Gus, I’m catching up late as usual, but I’m helping pull together who has tools, spare parts, and a couple hours to spare. Do you know what you can bring or who else I should check with?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Dane — I’m setting aside my tool chest, bike stand, tire kit, spare fasteners, and some small-appliance tools, plus I can bring bins or a folding table if Pia needs them. You might check with Cleo too; she’s tracking batteries and may know more about the storage and sign-up needs.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That’s perfect, Gus—I'll put you down for the tool chest, bike gear, fasteners, small-appliance tools, and possible bins or table. I’ll check with Cleo about batteries and sign-up/storage needs next.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, Oren—the repair drive is this weekend, and you’re already confirmed to help on the day. No specific item promised from you yet; tools and batteries are still needed if you have any.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, thank you, Leo—I’ve got it now: I’m helping on the day, and I’ll check whether I’ve got spare tools or batteries to bring.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect, thanks Oren. Just let me know what you find, and I’ll keep you down for helping on the day either way.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Hana, before I pass this around, can you confirm the exact date, time, meeting spot, and whether the community center is officially organizing the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I don’t want you to circulate anything unconfirmed yet, Kira — I’m still checking the official organizer, meeting spot, and exact time. For now, please just say the repair drive details are being confirmed and I’ll send the final wording once I verify them.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it, Hana — I won’t circulate specifics yet. I’ll just tell folks the repair drive details are still being confirmed and wait for your final wording.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Cleo, I’m helping Mara with the repair drive from 10 to noon between school runs. If you’re stopping by, Eli should have the repair list sorted so we can point you where help is needed.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Faye — I’ve got you, Mara, and Eli noted for list sorting from 10 to noon, and I’ll keep batteries, tape, and spare screws marked as still needed unless Mara confirms otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Cleo—that sounds right. I’ll check with Mara before 10 and let you know if she confirms anyone bringing batteries, tape, or spare screws.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Opal, update your sheet to 10 to noon, with the community room still tentative. Keep my tools pending until Nell confirms whether it’s really small appliances and bikes, and what Eli needs.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it, Mina—I’ll mark the time as 10 to noon, keep the community room tentative, and leave your tools pending until Nell confirms the repair categories and Eli’s needs.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Opal. If Hana or Nell sends the urgent list first, ping me right away so I can bring the right tools instead of guessing.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Bo, before we promise anything else, can you confirm whether you’re volunteering time, bringing supplies, or just spreading the word? I’m trying to keep Rosa’s list tidy and avoid surprises on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Put me down mainly for spreading the word and keeping Rosa’s list tidy for now, Pia. I can probably bring a roll of tape and some basic tools, but don’t count me for a time slot until the kickoff’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Bo—that helps; I’ll mark you for outreach and tentative tape/basic tools, but no time slot yet. Please send any names you gather straight to Rosa so her Sunday list stays clean.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hi Ira, I’m helping coordinate the repair drive—do you know if you can lend any screws, tape, batteries, basic tools, or maybe some time on the day?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hi Sam—I'm still out running errands, so I’ll check what I’ve got when I’m home and can probably spare some time too. Do you know the exact start time and meeting spot yet, so I can pass that along accurately?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Ira—that’d be a big help. I’m still waiting on the confirmed start time and meeting spot from Cleo or Kira, but I’ll let you know as soon as it’s settled.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hi Eli, I keep coming back to your simple plan — needs, skills, tools, and one Saturday morning. Do you want me to quietly start asking neighbors what they need fixed and what they can lend?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, please, Rey — that would help a great deal. If you can jot down each neighbor’s repair need, any tools they can lend, and whether they’re free 10 to noon Saturday, I’ll keep the master list tidy.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, Eli — I’ll ask quietly and note each repair need, lendable tools, and whether they’re free Saturday from 10 to noon. I’ll bring you whatever I gather so your master list stays tidy.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hey Uli—I'm a little behind, but I think Cleo’s checking what supplies we already have, and Dane’s waiting on that to spot tool gaps against the urgent repair list.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah — that matches what I’ve heard. I’ll keep telling folks the urgent items are Mrs. Park’s porch rail and gutter for now, but not firm assignments until Hana confirms the list and signups.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it, thanks—I'll try not to overpromise anything and just point people to Hana for the final list and signups.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Rosa, latest I’ve got is the repair drive is Saturday from 10 to noon at the community center, with Faye and Mara coordinating and Eli keeping the tools-and-needs list.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Tess—one correction: it’s been moved to Sunday at the community center, not Saturday. I’ll confirm the start time and make sure Faye, Mara, and Eli have the same update.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh goodness, thank you Rosa—I’ll stop telling folks Saturday and say Sunday at the community center, with the start time still pending your confirmation.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hi Vik, I’m keeping the repair drive supply list updated—do you know if anyone has confirmed batteries, basic tools, tape, or spare screws yet?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hi Cleo—so far Jules is gathering names for basic tools, spare parts, and volunteer time, but I haven’t heard firm confirmations on batteries, tape, or spare screws yet. I’ll point anyone with supplies your way and update you once Eli sends the schedule and drop-off details.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik—that’s helpful. I’ll mark basic tools and spare parts as tentative through Jules, and leave batteries, tape, and spare screws unconfirmed until we hear more.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hey Nell, I may be a little scattered, but I think Jules is sorting the signup list now, and Cleo’s checking supplies like tape and screws. If you can still ask folks what repairs they need most, that’d really help.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Noah — I’ll tell folks Jules has the signup list and Cleo’s checking supplies, but I’ll keep asking for the most urgent repairs and mark anything unconfirmed until Mara or Eli confirms it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: That sounds perfect, Nell—marking it unconfirmed is wise, since I’m probably missing a detail or two. I’ll point anyone with repair needs your way if I bump into them.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Leo, I only skimmed the list so far, but your note about Mrs. Park’s porch rail and gutter is the urgent one I’m flagging. I’m waiting on the fuller list before I start assigning people.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good—keep those two first. I’m still waiting on confirmed tools and supplies, so don’t assign people until Cleo or Mara sends the fuller list.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I’ll keep Mrs. Park’s rail and gutter at the top and hold off on assignments until Cleo or Mara sends the fuller list and we know the tools situation.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Eli, glad I caught you—folks are asking where to show up and when, so do you have the repair drive schedule and drop-off details yet?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, Sam—the repair drive is Saturday from 10 to noon, with Faye and Mara coordinating. Have folks bring repairs and any batteries, tape, screws, or basic tools to the main drop-off table, and I’ll keep the list moving.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Perfect, thanks Eli—I’ll pass along Saturday 10 to noon and point folks to the main drop-off table with repairs or any batteries, tape, screws, and basic tools.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hi Hana, I’m catching up between errands—do you have the confirmed repair list, start time, and meeting spot yet? Jules is ready to connect volunteers, but I don’t want to send folks the wrong way.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Ira — I’m still confirming the list and signups, so please don’t send Jules firm assignments yet. The likely urgent first repairs are Mrs. Park’s loose porch rail and leaking gutter, and I’ll circle back with the confirmed start time and meeting spot as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Got it, Hana—I’ll tell Jules not to make firm assignments yet, just keep folks on standby with basic tools. I’ll wait for your confirmed time and meeting spot before pointing anyone anywhere.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Mina, I’m helping Mara with the repair drive from just before 10 until noon, between school runs. If you’re coming by, Eli should have the repair list sorted so we can plug people in where they’re needed.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Faye. Do you already know which repairs are first priority, or should I wait for Eli’s list before telling people what tools to bring?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’d wait for Eli’s list before promising anything specific, but if folks ask now, tell them basic hand tools are safe to bring. I’ll check the urgent repairs with Mara when I get there just before 10.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Opal, I’m catching up a bit late, but I’m checking this afternoon on screwdrivers, pliers, tape, screws, and maybe a soldering iron—do you know what repairs we’re shortest on right now?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I don’t have the shortage list confirmed yet, Dane, but screwdrivers, pliers, tape, and screws are exactly the basics I’m tracking—check with Eli on the soldering iron or specific repair gaps, and I’ll mark you as checking this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect, thanks Opal—I’ll check with Eli about the soldering iron and repair gaps, then send you and Bo whatever I confirm this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Kira, I’m still waiting on the exact kickoff time, but I’ve got my tool chest, bike stand, tire kit, and spare fasteners ready. If you hear Pia needs storage bins, a folding table, or help keeping sign-ups orderly, send folks my way.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Gus — before I send anyone your way, can you confirm who told you Pia might be handling sign-ups, and where the repair drive is actually meeting?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Cleo’s the one who mentioned she’d pass along any word about Pia’s storage or sign-up needs, but I don’t have the meeting spot or kickoff time confirmed yet. I’d rather not point folks anywhere until Pia or Cleo pins that down.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Jules, I’m spreading the word about Saturday’s repair drive—10 to noon, with Faye and Mara coordinating. Want me to add you to the invite list or point you to Eli if you’ve got tools or something to fix?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes, please add me to the invite list, Quinn—and if you can point me to Eli too, I can help connect the tool folks with Faye and Mara without promising more than we’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, Jules—I’ll add you to the invite list and point you to Eli so you can help keep the tool folks synced with Faye and Mara.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Tess, we’ve got the repair drive set for 10 to noon, with Faye helping near setup and Leo checking on tools—can you help me pin down the urgent repairs list?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, Mara — I’ll steer folks with urgent fixes to Eli’s repair-needs list and flag batteries as the gap I’ve heard about so far.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Tess—that helps a lot. I’ll mark batteries as the current supply gap and keep Eli’s repair-needs list as our place for urgent fixes.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hi Rosa, I’m trying to keep this straight—the repair drive is Saturday 10 to noon, but I’ve already forgotten where we’re gathering. Do you know the spot?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Oren—small update: the repair drive has moved to Sunday at the community center, with the community room as our main drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thank you, Rosa—Sunday at the community center, community room drop-off. I’m writing that down before it slips away again.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hi Uli, I’m still piecing the repair drive together quietly — are you thinking more about bringing something to fix, lending tools, or helping with setup?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Mostly helping with setup and keeping the details straight, Rey. I’m going to check the notice board for the sign-up times before I point anyone the wrong way.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Uli — that would help a lot. If you see the times posted, could you let me know so I can keep asking neighbors about repairs and tools without sending them in circles?
